prints.title: Ghost headphones
prints.description: Charcoal, gray, and ivory PLA headphones sized for a 76 mm oatmeal gauze ghost, with a 71 mm cushion gap. They are shown on a display figure of that ghost (not printed) so you can see how they sit, with the band clearing the tuft.
prints.material: PLA Matte, charcoal, gray, and ivory
prints.alt: Small charcoal headphones with gray pads and ivory rings, shown on a display figure (not printed) of a beige gauze ghost holding an orange pumpkin

iterations.label: v1
iterations.note: First Python design, fitted to a 76 × 63.5 × 76 mm head with a 71 mm cushion gap. A sliced print file was not kept.

photo.alt: Render of the first, full-size headphone design

iterations.label: v2
iterations.note: A smaller revision for a 63 × 53 × 63 mm head with a 58 mm cushion gap. It does not fit the 76 mm gauze ghost, so it is not the model on the figure. A print of this revision was not confirmed.

photo.alt: Render of the smaller v2 headphone revision
